feedback: The investigation was somewhat complex because the error-based onset (second 62, payment) was a red herring unrelated to the actual latency symptom. The subagents used the error onset and missed the latency issue entirely. I had to manually trace the latency path through the slowest operations and identify the flagservice egress as the bottleneck. The `traces_latency_origin` tool pointed to shipping (324ms) which wasn't the real issue - the 20-second flagservice egress calls dwarfed it but may have been missed because they're client spans on frontend-proxy rather than server spans on the callee. The `investigate_parallel` delegation was mostly wasted because the agents anchored on error onset. For latency incidents, the triage phase should anchor on `metrics_detect_shift` for latency rather than `traces_first_error_time`. The `investigate_change` tool was the most useful for confirming the culprit.
